sources.snippet: Suggest to use bge v1.5, which alleviates the issue of the similarity distribution. Since we finetune the models by contrastive learning with a temperature of 0.01, the similarity distribution of the current BGE model is about in the interval [0.6, 1]. So a similarity score greater than 0.5 does not indicate that the two sentences are similar.
